note: Masks are bool arrays (height, width). text_mask: args s (the string) and scale. dilate: args r, arrays m and out. stamp: arrays "in" (the uint8 RGB frame before), mask, out; args x, y, color and the keywords exactly as passed (a keyword that is absent was not passed; outline null is outline=None; alpha is a float.hex() string).
